text:
sara: merged cust-verdant LoRA into staging and ran the quick invoice smoketest. seeing weird splits on thousands separator amounts (e.g. $1,234.56 -> prediction splits into '$1' and ',234.56' or drops comma).

evan: paste a tiny repro snippet?

sara: sure:

```
# command
python eval_pack/run_smoke.py --model verdant-lora-int4 --dataset samples/invoices/comma-sep.jsonl --metrics amount_parse_f1
# output
{"id":"inv-201","pred":"$1 ,234.56","gold":"$1,234.56"}
{"id":"inv-204","pred":"$5,000.00","gold":"$5,000.00"}
{"id":"inv-207","pred":"$12","gold":"$12.00"}
```

ciara: odd that some are ok and some split. fp16 baseline?

sara: fp16 baseline shows no splits. int4 seems to increase tokenization splits around commas and sometimes drops trailing decimals.

mike: any tokenizer merges in LoRA? LoRA should only touch weights, but tokenizer normalization can be impacted by subtle probability shifts. runtime recently swapped to a fused token-merging decode path for int4 that changes greedy tie-breaking.

evan: can you try: (A) int4 with decode fallback to standard merge, (B) int4 + greedy allow-split=false?

bench-bot: scheduled qb-3799991111-decode-ablation [cust-verdant,int4-comma-split], ETA ~6m

sara: quick ablation: (A) forcing standard merge path -> splits vanish on repro set. (B) disabling greedy split heuristics -> also fixes.

mike: that suggests the fused decode path with quantized logits changes argmax ordering for comma-adjacent tokens. not a tokenizer file change but decode-time tie-breaker sensitivity.

evan: short-term: pin cust-verdant to standard decode path on Dedicated and add a quick-eval in the merge gate for comma-separated amounts. medium-term: add deterministic tie-breaker to fused decode or run a calibration pass for numeric punctuation tokens.

ciara: +1. Also add a normalization postprocess in the eval pack to accept loose formats during matching (tolerate whitespace around comma).

deploy-bot: canary deploy blocked: "decode-behavior-regression" check failed for redwood/cust-verdant, manual approval required.

sara: opened MR updating quick-eval + onboarding note: https://git.internal/redwood/cust-verdant/merge-requests/7

mike: I'll instrument the fused decode to log argmax for comma-adjacent spans and run a small calibration on numeric tokens. posting findings in ~2h.

bench-bot: job qb-3799991111-decode-ablation finished: artifacts at /artifacts/qb-3799991111 (summary: fused decode path changes argmax on comma spans; standard decode stable).

evan: good catch. add playbook entry: "if LoRA onboarding shows numeric punctuation splits under int4, force standard decode until tie-breaker patch" :memo:

sara: done, PR merged to onboarding doc and quick-eval pack. thumbs up from ciara. :thumbsup:
